title: Blackened Snapper with Sweet Pepper Cream
description: A paprika crust meets sweet red pepper cream beneath flaky snapper.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

ingredients.name: peeled unsalted roasted red bell pepper, pureed
ground cayenne pepper
ingredients.note: Spicy serving only, at the table. Mild portions omit it.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Whisk {roastpep}, {milk}, {broth} into the HexClad. Simmer gently for 2 minutes until combined.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Whisk {starch} with {cold}, then stir into the simmering sauce for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.text: Remove from the heat and whisk in {creamcheese} until evenly incorporated.

steps.title: Prepare the dish
steps.text: Start with the room-temperature 4-qt glass container, no crisper plate. Let sauce cool to lukewarm before adding to the glass. Spread the sauce over the base.

steps.title: Season for two heat levels
steps.text: Mix {paprika}, {gpow}, {thyme} and {oil}. Rub the top of {snapper} with the paste. Keep the shared rub mild; reserve {cayenne} for the spicy serving.

steps.title: Cook in sauce
steps.text: Nestle the pieces in the sauce in a single layer. Fit the 4-qt adapter and PowerPod and select Bake. Cook for 10–15 minutes, checking the thickest piece early. For the blackened finish, switch to Air Fry for the last 1–2 minutes as the surface darkens. Finish at 145°F in the center.

steps.title: Serve generously
steps.text: Spoon hot sauce over each serving. For the spicy plate only, stir the reserved cayenne into its own spoonful of sauce.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the sauce a day ahead and refrigerate separately. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze cooked portions with sauce, cooled within 2 hours, for up to 2 months. Flaky fish is best freshly cooked; thaw slowly and keep covered. Fridge reheat: cover and warm gently with a spoonful of water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat covered to 165°F. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For gentler Option B, omit added citrus, vinegar or chile where used. Pass additional heat at the table. Dairy swap: use unsweetened oat milk and equivalent plain dairy-free cheese if needed. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 211 kcal, 28.2 g protein, 9.4 g total carbohydrate, 6.3 g fat, 1.2 g fiber, 127 mg sodium.

steps.text: Nestle the pieces in the sauce in a single layer. Place the baking dish on the middle rack. Cook for 12–18 minutes, checking the thickest piece early.
